author: Jerrryy
body:
Username: J3rry_
I got banned for saying that I did not hack.
I was using Macros. I recently found it out and got hooked... At first i wanted to test it out but then started using it for PVP. I forgot how good it was to actually kill someone someone legit. I hope that i will be unbanned but I will serve my tempban, I love the server alot and want to continue playing on it. I will stop using macros. Please consider my appeal. Thank You. 

.

title: Unban

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,  

This appeal is Denied.

Reason: Has had a recent punishment for Auto-clicking but was caught Auto-clicking again.

You have not learned from the first Temp-Ban and now it has to be a Perm-Ban.

Regards,
Lord_Draksis, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
